test_name: Media Protection - MP-4 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Claims-Processing-098
Primary NIST family: Media Protection (MP); evidence focus: MP-4.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: a legacy encrypted archive has not yet been migrated to the approved customer-managed key. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
